text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Kawakami-san and Urara-san. What 
are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san! We are currently building a 
birdhouse together!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A birdhouse...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We found a broken nest! Kawakami-chan and 
I were talking about how it must've been 
because of the typhoon the other day!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So we decided to make a new home for them, 
and Kawakami-chan and I are doing our best 
right now!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? How admirable of you both.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. To receive praise from King-san is 
such an honor!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's put our spirit into 
building this nest! DOSSEEEEIIIIII!!!
(CRASH-SMASH!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!? The birdhouse has been shattered 
to smithereens!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you swing a hammer down with that much 
force, of course that's going to happen!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tap-tap, clack-clack~♪ Ehehe! Making a 
home for the birdies is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nice one, Urara-san! Next, let's see... 
align the two side panels to the edge of 
the backboard, and hammer in the nails!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san? You shouldn't just read the 
online instructions verbatim. Break it 
down!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eh... break the smartphone!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Break down the explanation! ...Wait, 
Urara-san!? The nail is bent!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It really is! Hammering nails is 
pretty tough, huh~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. I shall lend a hand, so let 
us divide up the work.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...No, King-san. It is difficult to say, 
but we are fine without your help!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Wh-Why? King herself is offering to 
assist you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! If King-san were here, 
building a hundred birdhouses would be a 
piece of cake! In truth, I want your help 
overwhelmingly!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, that would not do. Because—I want 
to become someone you can be proud of, 
King-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Previously, King-san—you helped Mayano-san 
and Tannhauser-san, did you not?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
They both told me that King-san taught 
them—what it means to "never give up."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if you couldn't cook, even if you 
knew nothing about figures—you saw both of 
their requests through. Like a true 
first-class lady, until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is why I do not wish to give up just 
yet. —Just like you, King-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-san...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know what! I feel the exact same way! 
I want to keep trying until the end with 
Kawakami-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even Urara-san... Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since you turned down King's help, I will 
not accept any half-baked results! You 
understand that, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Urara-san, let's do 
thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're definitely gonna finish the 
birdhouse~! Let's go~~!!

One day, I spotted a magnificent birdhouse 
high up in a tree at the academy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! To notice that right away, you 
are quite an observant Trainer, aren't 
you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you think!? That birdhouse 
is a magnificent masterpiece, is it not!? 
You may offer your praises! I grant you 
the privilege, come on!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's an incredible piece of work!

text_block_list.text:

is a magnificent masterpiece, is it not!?

choice_data_list: Yeah, it's an incredible piece of work!

...Why do you look so proud of it?
...Why do you look so proud of it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, naturally, naturally! It took quite 
some time, but in return, both its 
durability and functionality are 
impeccable!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Take a look. The chicks have regained 
their energy and look ready to take flight 
any moment now, don't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Truly... they grow up before you even know 
it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh—Never mind that part!? Just give me 
your impressions!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look, like how sturdy it seems! Or how 
beautiful the design is... There are 
plenty of wonderful things to say about 
it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To look upon such a first-class creation 
and not have a single word of praise—how 
utterly unrefined!
